target_customer: Startups and companies with recruiting teams that hire technical talent
problem: Recruiters spend many hours sourcing candidates and writing outreach; cold outreach has low reply rates.
business_model: B2B SaaS for recruiting teams (pricing not found)

founders.name: Alan Wang
founders.background_notes: Former data engineer at Disney+ per YC page.

founders.name: Albert Stanley
founders.background_notes: Named as co-founder by one aggregator only.

technical_complexity.rationale: Sourcing and outreach automation over LinkedIn, GitHub and ATS data uses standard LLM and integration work, though data access is a dependency.

defensibility.rationale: Many AI recruiting tools exist and the product wraps public data sources, so copying is quick; a warm introduction graph could add network effects later.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent action against it found as of the search.

market_need_then: Recruiting is a large spend category and the company says recruiters save about 15 hours per role; the claims are self-reported.

branding.domain_note: Uses serra.io; no acquisition history found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Positions itself as a 24/7 AI recruiter

branding.community_and_virality: Product Hunt launch in September 2024 reported as number one product of the day (aggregator claim).

brand_strength.rationale: Some launch traction but name shared with many other Serra brands and no brand press found.

outcome_analysis: Serra is a Summer 2023 YC company that is still listed as active with about 8 people and claims to hire for around 100 customers. Funding seen is a roughly 500 thousand dollar pre-seed reported by aggregators only, and no shutdown, layoff or acquisition news was found, so the outcome is still open.
notes: The 500K pre-seed (Seedtable and CB Insights, both aggregators, Y Combinator and Team Ignite Ventures) is unverified and not recorded as a round. The company site returned HTTP 503. No dated 2023 competitor sources found. Do not confuse with Sera (Estonia) or serra.ai. Completeness pass: the $500K pre-seed of 2023-09 rests on Seedtable (single database; Persana dates it 2023-10-06, VCBacked agrees on amount); Team Ignite Ventures appears only in Seedtable.
